tool_input.command:
cd /Users/ray/Coding/magic-agent-video-generator/V2/bench/mcp/fleet && node chat.mjs s2.new.stupid.F32b plan_video_production "$(cat <<'EOF'
{"request":"make a podcast from this [article: Why cities are planting tiny forests] — two hosts, a guy and a girl, about 90 sec. no music",
"story":{"title":"Tiny Forests podcast","aspect":"16:9","audio":true,
"setting":"A cozy podcast studio with warm soft light, wooden desk, two studio microphones on arms, foam panels and a few potted plants behind; realistic, steady medium shot.",
"subjects":[{"id":"her","words":"a woman podcast host in her early 30s with shoulder-length dark hair, wearing a green sweater, seated at the left microphone","role":"person"},
{"id":"him","words":"a man podcast host in his early 30s with short brown hair and a beard, wearing a grey t-shirt, seated at the right microphone","role":"person"}],
"beats":[
{"seconds":8,"text":"Both hosts at their microphones; the woman speaks to the man","place":"studio","subjects":["her","him"],"link":"new","clip":1,"spoken":["Welcome back to the show. Today: why cities are planting tiny forests."]},
{"seconds":7,"text":"The man answers, amused","place":"studio","subjects":["her","him"],"link":"continues","clip":1,"spoken":["Tiny forests? Like... bonsai trees?"]},
{"seconds":8,"text":"The woman laughs and explains","place":"studio","subjects":["her","him"],"link":"continues","clip":2,"spoken":["Not quite. Picture an empty lot the size of a tennis court, packed with native trees."]},
{"seconds":7,"text":"The man leans in and asks","place":"studio","subjects":["her","him"],"link":"continues","clip":2,"spoken":["Packed how tightly?"]},
{"seconds":9,"text":"The woman explains, counting on her fingers","place":"studio","subjects":["her","him"],"link":"continues","clip":3,"spoken":["Three to five saplings per square metre, in enriched soil. It's the method of Japanese botanist Akira Miyawaki."]},
{"seconds":6,"text":"The man nods and replies","place":"studio","subjects":["her","him"],"link":"continues","clip":3,"spoken":["So the trees compete for light and grow fast."]},
{"seconds":8,"text":"The woman nods and answers","place":"studio","subjects":["her","him"],"link":"continues","clip":4,"spoken":["Exactly. Supporters say a tiny forest can sustain itself in about three years."]},
{"seconds":7,"text":"The man asks","place":"studio","subjects":["her","him"],"link":"continues","clip":4,"spoken":["And what do cities get out of it?"]},
{"seconds":8,"text":"The woman lists the benefits","place":"studio","subjects":["her","him"],"link":"continues","clip":5,"spoken":["Cooler streets, more insects and birds, and a place for schoolchildren to learn."]},
{"seconds":7,"text":"The man raises an eyebrow","place":"studio","subjects":["her","him"],"link":"continues","clip":5,"spoken":["Sounds great. But I'm guessing there's a catch."]},
{"seconds":15,"text":"The woman answers seriously","place":"studio","subjects":["her","him"],"link":"continues","clip":6,"spoken":["Critics say the evidence is still thin. Many projects are too young to measure, and dense planting can mean many saplings die."]},
{"seconds":9,"text":"The man speaks thoughtfully","place":"studio","subjects":["her","him"],"link":"continues","clip":7,"spoken":["And urban ecologists agree: a tiny forest is no substitute for protecting existing large trees, which store far more carbon."]},
{"seconds":6,"text":"The woman smiles and signs off","place":"studio","subjects":["her","him"],"link":"continues","clip":7,"spoken":["Plant small, protect big. Thanks for listening!"]}
]}}
EOF
)"
